_comment: tvbridge configuration. Copy to $TVBRIDGE_HOME/config.json (default ~/.tvbridge/config.json) with 'python -m tvbridge init', which also generates server.secret. Keys starting with '_' are comments and are ignored; any other unknown key is an error. Omitted keys fall back to built-in defaults.

server._comment: Webhook listener. Bind to 127.0.0.1 and expose it with ngrok. secret must be a random string >= 16 chars and must match the 'secret' field of every TradingView alert. The placeholder below is rejected on purpose: run 'python -m tvbridge init'. tradingview_ips is TradingView's published webhook source list (checked against X-Forwarded-For from ngrok).

account._comment: Prop account. server_utc_offset_hours is the MT5 server clock offset in hours (Hantec: GMT+3; GMT+2 in northern winter if the broker shifts DST -- check the Market Watch clock), or "auto" for UTC+3 while US daylight saving time is in effect and UTC+2 otherwise (brokers whose day ends at the New York close; switches e.g. on 1 Nov 2026). account_login / server_name, if set, must appear in the MT5 main window title (guards against trading the wrong account).
account.name: Hantec Endurance 50k

risk._comment: All percentages are of balance unless stated. Firm limits: daily_loss_pct (from the day's reference = max(balance, equity) at 00:00 server time) and max_loss_pct (static, from initial_balance). *_buffer_pct keep entries away from those limits; kill_buffer_pct triggers an emergency flatten. Times are server time HH:MM; trading_days_server uses Mon=0..Sun=6; friday_cutoff_server null disables it.

symbols._comment: Symbols are keyed by normalized TradingView symbol (OANDA:EURUSD, EUR/USD and EURUSD.h all become EURUSD). The MT5 name is map[symbol] if present, else symbol + suffix. allowed: empty list = every symbol in specs. commission_per_lot_usd in a spec (null = risk.commission_per_lot_usd) is the round-trip commission per 1.00 lot of that symbol.

specs._comment: IMPORTANT: contract_size, digits, point, lot_step and min_lot MUST be checked against Hantec's product specification table (and the MT5 'Specification' window for each symbol) before going live -- position sizing depends on them. contract_size is units per 1.0 lot; quote is the quote currency; min_sl_points is the minimum stop distance in points. Set a symbol to null to remove a default.

executor._comment: mode: 'paper' (simulated, default), 'rehearsal' (drives MT5 but presses Escape instead of Buy/Sell) or 'live'. Always rehearse on a DEMO account first. gui holds MT5 window matching and timing for the GUI executor.

mirror._comment: Mirror mode (action 'sync', see README 'Mirror mode' and tradingview/ALERTS.md). One TradingView strategy alert on every order fill reports the strategy's position; tvbridge makes the MT5 position on that symbol match it. units_per_lot: strategy units per 1.00 MT5 lot (gold: 100 oz). stop_distance: broker-side protective stop in price units, measured from the MT5 ticket's own quote (a safety net; normal exits come from alerts). tp_distance 0 = no take-profit. size_tolerance_lots: differences up to this count as in sync. max_price_gap_pct: an entry is refused when the alert price and the MT5 quote differ by more. allow_adds false: never add to an open position. fan_out: mirror one alert symbol onto several MT5 symbols, each as its own position with the full strategy size, e.g. {"XAUUSD": ["XAUUSD", "XAUUSDMICRO"]} (every target needs a symbols.specs entry; see README 'Mirror fan-out'). units_per_lot_by_symbol: per-symbol override of units_per_lot, e.g. {"XAUUSDMICRO": 10} for a 10 oz micro lot. stop_distance_by_symbol / tp_distance_by_symbol: per-symbol overrides of stop_distance / tp_distance, e.g. {"XAGUSD": 1.4}.

notify._comment: Notification channels. macos uses Notification Center; ntfy_url e.g. https://ntfy.sh/<your-topic>; Telegram needs both bot token and chat id. min_level: debug | info | warn | critical.

ngrok._comment: ngrok agent auth token and your reserved domain (host name only, no https://). Used by install.sh and 'python -m tvbridge ngrok-config'.
